channel.title: Pink iPod
channel.description: Independent music blog: long interviews with emerging artists, listening diaries and playlists.

item.title: The online kid who finally went outside : Lovebuzz
item.dc:creator: Pink iPod
item.description:
Lovebuzz, 20, half American and half French, on GarageBand at 12, Bob Dylan’s deadpan, the colourful new Paris scene, singing in two languages and the EP he is finally preparing.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: Listen to Eistir with your phone on your chest
item.dc:creator: Pink iPod
item.description:

item.title: The Little Grandad Equation
item.dc:creator: Pink iPod
item.description:
My first interview at the Pitchfork Paris Festival: Little Grandad, four friends on their 98th show of the year, on regional tours, a clown costume grandad and the equation of endless energy.

item.title: I don’t think Paulie Swan is cynical
item.dc:creator: Pink iPod
item.description:
I met Paulie Swan, the Edinburgh songwriter, around his show at Pitchfork Music Festival Paris. We talked about cartoons, his keyboard bought with Bandcamp money, Swan Lake (he never saw it), and hope against cynicism.

item.title: My official interview with god (Petra)
item.dc:creator: Pink iPod
item.description:
I met Petra after her show at Pitchfork Music Festival Paris. We talked about her recent electrocution, her vintage robe, pigeons, Kanye, and the song she wants played at her funeral.
